answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 30 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The violet register is checked at draw time, falcon lists the eligible set, and basalt seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 30 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party burns for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
